permissionBasis.appliesTo: Published imagery under science.nasa.gov/earth, including the downloaded topography JPEG; no claim to have obtained raw GEBCO gridded data
permissionBasis.finding: NASA Earth FAQ permits republication/reuse including commercial purposes except materials marked with copyright. The specific topography page credits NASA imagery and underlying GEBCO data and contains no separately indicated copyright holder for that image. Preserve all source/processing credits.
permissionBasis.scopeCaveat: This records the published image reuse basis. It does not grant blanket rights to raw third-party grids, assert CC0 for every GEBCO version, or establish a fresh pixel reconstruction.

rightsChecks.finding: Legacy GEBCO_08 gridded-data documentation is indexed with version-specific restrictions; its old and candidate relocated PDF URLs did not return a readable current document. The indexed wording must not be treated as an applicable prohibition on NASA-published JPEG imagery without establishing that scope. No such scope relation has been established.

Current GEBCO 2026 documentation permits copying, distribution, adaptation and commercial exploitation with source acknowledgment and conditions. No verified statement has yet applied those new-version terms retroactively to the GEBCO_08 raster.

File page identifies NASA Visible Earth and cmglee and a public-domain NASA license. A primary source page for this particular derivative is available, but it does not itself prove the present China texture pixels came from that file.

Current NASA Earth imagery policy permits reuse and republication, including commercial purposes, except where copyright is indicated; asks NASA credit. This is a direct reuse-policy basis for the concrete NASA-published image, rather than a bare inference from its hosting domain.

rightsChecks.sourceDiscovery: Linked as terms of use by current official GEBCO historical-data page
rightsChecks.finding: Current official archived terms for GEBCO One Minute Grid 2008 explicitly allow copying, distribution, adaptation and commercial exploitation with acknowledgment, no endorsement and no misrepresentation. One Minute 2008 is not assumed to be identical to GEBCO_08; this record further cautions against assigning a universal prohibition from an inaccessible old PDF.
